$comment: 听力训练营 L33（P-L3 续跑，阶段三第十三课，综合两句判断段）。脚本 100% 原创；Part 3 每题需综合前后两句判断（帐篷暖睡袋好+一闭眼就听到动静→问为什么没睡好；生火一小时香肠烤黑+和大家一起吃自己做的最棒→问感受；大家都想爬山天气好+山路暴风雨后关闭→问为什么去湖边；第一小时找手机+第二天不想它了→问看法；很想去父母同意+睡袋薄要借暖的→问态度）+ Part 5 匹配（Jamie 告诉妈妈五个朋友露营各带什么，8 样东西 A-H 全部被反复提到，靠「最后决定」判断，选项为短语）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: The Camping Trip
intro: 先听 Isla 和 Jamie 聊周末的露营：为什么没睡好？在火上做饭是什么感受？为什么没去爬山？没有手机的周末怎么样？答案都要把前后两句合起来想——前一句常是「好的一面」，后一句才是真正的原因和感受。再听 Jamie 告诉妈妈下次露营五个朋友各带什么——8 样东西都会被反复提到，有人先说带一样，后来换了，要听「最后定下来带什么」。

sections.intro: 听 Isla 和 Jamie 聊周末的露营。五道题的答案都要把前后两句合起来想：前一句常是「好的一面」，后一句才是真正的原因和感受。

script.text: Jamie, you look tired. Didn't you sleep in the tent on Saturday?

Not much. The tent was warm, and my sleeping bag was great. But every time I closed my eyes, I heard a noise outside. It was only the wind, I know that now, but at three in the morning I didn't know that.
It was the wind all night. I slept like a baby.
You were busy cooking, that's why. How was that? The fire took an hour to light.
It did, and the sausages were black on the outside. But sitting there with everyone, eating something you cooked yourself, was the best part of the weekend. I'd do it every night.
The walk on Sunday was good too. But why did we go to the lake? Everyone wanted the mountain, and the weather was perfect.
Ben's dad looked at the map in the morning. The path up the mountain was closed after the storm last week. So it was the lake or nothing.
I didn't know that. Well, the lake was beautiful.
And no phones all weekend! How was that for you? You always have yours in your hand.
For the first hour I kept looking for it. It felt strange. But by Sunday I didn't miss it at all, and I talked to people much more. I think everyone should try it.
I agree.
So, are you coming again next month? Ben's dad is taking a group to the forest.
I'd love to, and my parents have already said yes. The thing is, it'll be colder next month, and my sleeping bag is thin. If I can borrow a warmer one, I'll be there.
My sister has one. I'll ask her tonight.

questions.q: Why didn't Jamie sleep well on Saturday?
options: He was cold in the tent.
He was worried about the noises.
His sleeping bag was not very good.
questions.explain: 前一句 The tent was warm, and my sleeping bag was great（帐篷暖、睡袋好）+ 后一句 every time I closed my eyes, I heard a noise outside… at three in the morning I didn't know that——是外面的动静让他不敢睡。冷和睡袋都被前一句排除了。

questions.q: How does Isla feel about cooking on the fire?
questions.explain: 前一句 The fire took an hour to light… the sausages were black（麻烦、烤糊）+ 后一句 But sitting there with everyone… was the best part of the weekend. I'd do it every night——虽然麻烦，她很享受。

questions.q: Why did they walk to the lake and not the mountain?
questions.explain: 前一句 Everyone wanted the mountain, and the weather was perfect（都想爬山、天气好）+ 后一句 The path up the mountain was closed after the storm——山路关了，只能去湖边。

questions.q: What does Jamie think about camping without phones?
options: He missed his phone all weekend.
He thinks it was a good thing.
questions.explain: 前一句 For the first hour I kept looking for it. It felt strange（一开始不习惯）+ 后一句 by Sunday I didn't miss it at all… I think everyone should try it——最后觉得很好。「整个周末都想手机」不对，只有第一个小时。

questions.q: What does Isla say about going camping next month?
options: She will go if she can get a warmer sleeping bag.
She can't go because of her parents.
She doesn't want to go when it is cold.
questions.explain: 前一句 I'd love to, and my parents have already said yes（想去、父母同意）+ 后一句 my sleeping bag is thin. If I can borrow a warmer one, I'll be there——条件是借到暖和的睡袋。

sections.intro: 听 Jamie 告诉妈妈下次露营五个朋友各带什么。把每个人和右边 A-H 的东西配起来。8 样东西都会被反复提到，有人先说带一样，后来换了——要听「最后定下来带什么」。

script.text: Jamie, is everything ready for the camping trip on Friday? Who's bringing what?
Yes, Mum. Ben is bringing the tent, his dad's big one. Everyone thought he'd bring a football too, but there's no room in the car for a football.
And Amy? She said something about a map.
She wanted to bring a map, but Ben's dad has a better one, so Amy is bringing the food. She's making sandwiches and a big cake.
Good. And who's bringing the matches for the fire?
Noah said he'd bring the matches, but his mum said no, he's too young. Ben's dad will bring the matches. So Noah is bringing a big torch, so we can see at night.
That's better. What about Ruby?
Ruby wanted to bring a football at first, for the evenings. But there's no room, so she's bringing warm blankets. It'll be cold at night.
Very good. And Leo?
Leo said he'd bring the food, but he can't cook, and Amy's doing it. So Leo is bringing a guitar, and we'll sing by the fire.
A guitar, but no football. And you?
Me? Just my sleeping bag, and the warm one from my sister for Isla.
Then let's hope it doesn't rain.

questions.explain: Ben is bringing the tent, his dad's big one——足球是大家以为的，车里没地方。
She wanted to bring a map, but Ben's dad has a better one, so Amy is bringing the food——先说地图，后改成食物。
Noah said he'd bring the matches, but his mum said no… So Noah is bringing a big torch——先说火柴，妈妈不让，改成手电筒。火柴由 Ben 爸爸带。
Ruby wanted to bring a football at first… But there's no room, so she's bringing warm blankets——先说足球，后改成毯子。
Leo said he'd bring the food, but he can't cook… So Leo is bringing a guitar——先说食物，后改成吉他。足球、地图、火柴三样都被提到多次，但没有人带。
